definitions.explanation: Making an exact copy of a document, image, or other material. A formal term often used in official and technical contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{複写|ふくしゃ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{複写|ふくしゃ}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧です。
examples.english: Copying of this material is prohibited.

examples.japanese: ⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{複写|ふくしゃ}⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}して→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コピー→コピー：04883_kopii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I used the library's reproduction service to get a copy of the paper.

notes: More formal than ⟦コピー→コピー：04883_kopii⟧ (copy). Common collocations: {複写|ふくしゃ}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ (no copying allowed), ⟦{複写機|ふくしゃき}→複写機：24248_fukushaki⟧ (copier, photocopier), {複写|ふくしゃ}⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧ (reproduction service). Often seen on official documents, library signs, and copyright notices. In computing contexts, ⟦コピー→コピー：04883_kopii⟧ is generally preferred over {複写|ふくしゃ}. Related term: ⟦{複製|ふくせい}→複製：17528_fukusei⟧ (reproduction/replica), which emphasizes creating an identical copy of an object or work of art.
